Reduce the scene of violent confrontation between the Nexalites and police, particularly by reducing shots showing machine gun fire and people dying, and deleting visuals, words and sentences indicative of extremely vindictive and revengeful attitude of the police.

After Amar Kal is taken away by police, delete entirely the scene in which the policeman is bribed and is shown to be in complete collusion with the pimp with regard to his profession of selling women.
Reduce to a mere suggestion necessary for continuity the sequence of torture of a Nexalite in very brutal manner by the police for extracting information from him.
Prior to the death of the Nexalite boy, delete/drastically reduce the gruesome shot of his hand full of blood, after he puts it in his wound and takes it out.
Reduce the medium long shot of the dead face of the Nexalite with eyes open and his mother crying by his side.
Delete part of the scene in which a policeman accepts bribe from Anand Ganguli.
Reduce the scene in which Anand is killed, by reducing the number of shots showing his blood-smeared face.
Reduce in length the repulsive close shot of blood vomitted by Naghu.
Reduce considerably the whipping of Naghu.
Reduce whipping of Naghu's father.
Reduce the court scene deleting the portion showing the judge to be produced against Nexalites.

Suitably modify the sequence containing answers given by Comrade Dada so as to dilute the impression that the police is violent and vindictive and only way to solve the problem of social injustice is through violence.
